result.question: What did the man of God do after speaking with the king?

readings.answer: He went another way and did not return by the way he had come to Bethel.
readings.support: went another way and did not return by the way he had come to Bethel

assessments.reason: Verse 10 explicitly says the man of God went another way and did not return by the way he had come to Bethel, matching the answer; v11 confirms he had spoken to the king.
